statement: Let G=K_{3,3} on the labelled parts P={p1,p2,p3} and Q={q1,q2,q3}. Let R(G) have as vertices all labelled maximal compatible tubings under exactly the tube and compatibility definitions frozen in source.md and problem.md, retaining the common full tube and taking no quotient by automorphisms; join two vertices exactly when one non-full tube is exchanged. Then diam R(K_{3,3})=12.
contribution: An exact computer-assisted resolution of the frozen assertion. A root/component recursion exhaustively constructs 552 graph search trees; direct legal parent-child rotations construct 1,380 edges and agree exactly with a structurally separate maximal-tubing/ridge enumeration. Exact BFS from every state covers all 304,704 ordered pairs, proves that every distance is at most 12, and supplies a checked distance-12 pair and explicit 12-rotation path. The cited prior range is [10,13]; the bounded source screen does not establish priority.
